description: A grand transitional kitchen with strong Mediterranean-European character. The ceiling is defined by a coffered grid of dark-stained wood beams with substantial depth, creating rich architectural contrast against the smooth white plaster walls. Wide arched openings frame the kitchen on both sides — one leading to a dark entryway, the other to a staircase with dark wood treads and a wrought-iron railing. Cabinetry throughout is painted a soft warm grey in a classic inset Shaker profile; the backsplash and countertops are thick white marble with dramatic grey veining. The kitchen island is clad in a painted grey wash finish with column-like corner details, topped by the same thick marble slab. Four bentwood-style round stools in dark walnut with a casual café aesthetic pull up to the island. On the island surface, a wooden bowl holds green apples and a tall clear glass vase carries a full arrangement of white flowering branches. On the perimeter counter, small white-potted herbs flank the matte-black bridge faucet. Herringbone-patterned dark hardwood floors run throughout, warming the light stone-and-grey palette considerably. Warm golden glow from above washes down over the island counter in two distinct halos, illuminating the marble surface below. Camera is at standing eye-level in a centered, slightly elevated composition — one-point perspective looking straight toward the back wall, with the island in the midground.
